segments.source: L02. Kleyko, D., Rachkovskij, D. A., Osipov, E., and Rahimi, A. A Survey on Hyperdimensional Computing aka Vector Symbolic Architectures, Part II: Applications, Cognitive Models, and Challenges. ACM Computing Surveys, 55(9), 2023. DOI: 10.1145/3558000. Preprint: arXiv:2112.15424. Relevant to the distinction between a representation family and a complete cognitive architecture.
segments.translation: L02. Kleyko, D., Rachkovskij, D. A., Osipov, E., and Rahimi, A. A Survey on Hyperdimensional Computing aka Vector Symbolic Architectures, Part II: Applications, Cognitive Models, and Challenges. ACM Computing Surveys, 55(9), 2023. DOI: 10.1145/3558000. Preprint: arXiv:2112.15424. Relevant pentru distincția dintre o familie de reprezentări și o arhitectură cognitivă completă.

segments.source: L03. Clarkson, K. L., Ubaru, S., and Yang, E. Capacity Analysis of Vector Symbolic Architectures. 2023. arXiv:2301.10352. Relevant to task-specific representation capacity and the connections with sketching and Bloom filters. It is not a theorem about the capacity of every proposed VSA extension.
segments.translation: L03. Clarkson, K. L., Ubaru, S., and Yang, E. Capacity Analysis of Vector Symbolic Architectures. 2023. arXiv:2301.10352. Relevant pentru capacitatea reprezentării specifică sarcinii și legăturile cu schițele compacte și filtrele Bloom. Nu este o teoremă despre capacitatea fiecărei extensii VSA propuse.

segments.source: L04. Frady, E. P., Kent, S., Olshausen, B. A., and Sommer, F. T. Resonator Networks for Factoring Distributed Representations of Data Structures. 2020. arXiv:2007.03748. Relevant as prior work on an additional mechanism for recovering factors of distributed structures.
segments.translation: L04. Frady, E. P., Kent, S., Olshausen, B. A., and Sommer, F. T. Resonator Networks for Factoring Distributed Representations of Data Structures. 2020. arXiv:2007.03748. Relevant ca lucrare anterioară despre un mecanism suplimentar de recuperare a factorilor structurilor distribuite.

segments.source: L05. Camposampiero, G., Hersche, M., Terzić, A., Wattenhofer, R., Sebastian, A., and Rahimi, A. Towards Learning Abductive Reasoning using VSA Distributed Representations. NeSy 2024. arXiv:2406.19121. Relevant to ARLC and the existing combination of programmed knowledge and learned abstract rules.
segments.translation: L05. Camposampiero, G., Hersche, M., Terzić, A., Wattenhofer, R., Sebastian, A., and Rahimi, A. Towards Learning Abductive Reasoning using VSA Distributed Representations. NeSy 2024. arXiv:2406.19121. Relevant pentru ARLC și combinația existentă de cunoștințe programate și reguli abstracte învățate.

segments.source: L06. Carzaniga, F., Hersche, M., Schindler, K., and Rahimi, A. Practical Lessons on Vector-Symbolic Architectures in Deep Learning-Inspired Environments. NeSy 2025, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research, 284, 218–236. Relevant to linear readout and practical representation choices. The Eos decoder correction is not claimed as an invention of linear readout.
segments.translation: L06. Carzaniga, F., Hersche, M., Schindler, K., and Rahimi, A. Practical Lessons on Vector-Symbolic Architectures in Deep Learning-Inspired Environments. NeSy 2025, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research, 284, 218–236. Relevant pentru citirea liniară și alegerile practice de reprezentare. Corecția decodorului Eos nu este revendicată ca invenție a citirii liniare.

segments.source: L07. Tomkins-Flanagan, E., and Kelly, M. A. Hey Pentti, We Did It!: A Fully Vector-Symbolic Lisp. 2025 preprint, arXiv:2510.17889; the record also identifies a MathPsych/ICCM 2024 abstract. Relevant to general computation with explicitly included cleanup memory. Expressivity does not establish practical language-model efficiency.
segments.translation: L07. Tomkins-Flanagan, E., and Kelly, M. A. Hey Pentti, We Did It!: A Fully Vector-Symbolic Lisp. Prepublicare din 2025, arXiv:2510.17889; înregistrarea identifică și un rezumat MathPsych/ICCM 2024. Relevant pentru calculul general cu memorie de dezambiguizare inclusă explicit. Expresivitatea nu stabilește eficiența practică a modelului de limbaj.

segments.source: L08. Kymn, C. J., Kleyko, D., Frady, E. P., Bybee, C., Kanerva, P., Sommer, F. T., and Olshausen, B. A. Computing with Residue Numbers in High-Dimensional Representation. 2023. arXiv:2311.04872. Relevant as prior work on arithmetic-oriented extensions to the VSA operation family.
segments.translation: L08. Kymn, C. J., Kleyko, D., Frady, E. P., Bybee, C., Kanerva, P., Sommer, F. T., and Olshausen, B. A. Computing with Residue Numbers in High-Dimensional Representation. 2023. arXiv:2311.04872. Relevant ca lucrare anterioară despre extensii orientate spre aritmetică ale familiei de operații VSA.

segments.source: L09. Roller, S., Sukhbaatar, S., Szlam, A., and Weston, J. Hash Layers For Large Sparse Models. 2021. arXiv:2106.04426. Relevant to non-learned sparse routing and the need for stronger novelty claims than inexpensive deterministic expert selection.
segments.translation: L09. Roller, S., Sukhbaatar, S., Szlam, A., and Weston, J. Hash Layers For Large Sparse Models. 2021. arXiv:2106.04426. Relevant pentru rutarea rară neînvățată și necesitatea unor afirmații de noutate mai puternice decât selectarea deterministă ieftină a experților.

segments.source: L10. Willsey, M., Nandi, C., Wang, Y. R., Flatt, O., Tatlock, Z., and Panchekha, P. egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation. POPL 2021. DOI: 10.1145/3434304. Preprint: arXiv:2004.03082. Relevant to structured expression sharing, equivalence, and rewrite-based optimisation.
segments.translation: L10. Willsey, M., Nandi, C., Wang, Y. R., Flatt, O., Tatlock, Z., and Panchekha, P. egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation. POPL 2021. DOI: 10.1145/3434304. Preprint: arXiv:2004.03082. Relevant pentru partajarea expresiilor structurate, echivalență și optimizare bazată pe rescriere.

segments.source: L11. Green, T. J., Karvounarakis, G., and Tannen, V. Provenance Semirings. Proceedings of the Twenty-Sixth ACM SIGMOD-SIGACT-SIGART Symposium on Principles of Database Systems, 31–40, 2007. DOI: 10.1145/1265530.1265535. Relevant to algebraic accounts of input dependence; provenance algebra itself is not a new SOP contribution.
segments.translation: L11. Green, T. J., Karvounarakis, G., and Tannen, V. Provenance Semirings. Proceedings of the Twenty-Sixth ACM SIGMOD-SIGACT-SIGART Symposium on Principles of Database Systems, 31–40, 2007. DOI: 10.1145/1265530.1265535. Relevant pentru descrierile algebrice ale dependenței de intrări; algebra provenienței în sine nu este o contribuție SOP nouă.

segments.source: L12. Lu, C. [Chris], Lu, C. [Cong], Lange, R. T., Foerster, J., Clune, J., and Ha, D. The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery. 2024. arXiv:2408.06292. Prior work on automated research, not validation of this audit.
segments.translation: L12. Lu, C. [Chris], Lu, C. [Cong], Lange, R. T., Foerster, J., Clune, J., and Ha, D. The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery. 2024. arXiv:2408.06292. Lucrare anterioară despre cercetare automatizată, nu validare a acestui audit.

segments.source: This edition is intentionally public at http://scriptahub.com/. The most useful feedback is technical: reproducible counterexamples, stronger baselines, alternative operator families, evidence that a claimed limitation is only an implementation artifact, or demonstrations that one of the open experiments can be pushed substantially further. The book should be read as a frozen analysis of a research phase, not as the final statement of the programme.
segments.translation: Această ediție este intenționat publică la http://scriptahub.com/. Cel mai util feedback este tehnic: contraexemple reproductibile, referințe mai puternice, familii alternative de operatori, dovezi că o limită afirmată este doar un artefact al implementării sau demonstrații că unul dintre experimentele deschise poate fi împins substanțial mai departe. Cartea trebuie citită ca o analiză fixată a unei etape de cercetare, nu ca afirmația finală a programului.
